g.text: Place-Order Saga Transaction (OrderDomainEntity Lifecycle & Progressive State Accumulation)
Customer places an order via API gateway / web store.
OrderDomainEntity is created with initial payload:
Queries User-Service to fetch address & profile.
They update the state object but do not require doRevert().
Calls Order-Service to generate and record order entry.
Cancels/voids order record if saga downstream fails
State mutations are ONLY permitted during doProcess().
doRevert() compensations do not alter the DomainEntity.
Reserves purchased items in inventory via Stock-Service.
Releases inventory hold if subsequent payment fails
ℹ State Preserved: Communicates with stock without adding new fields.
Processes customer payment transaction via Payment-Service.
Triggers refund / release if payment phase requires rollback
Final step of the place-order transaction workflow.
On successful return, the saga lifecycle reaches COMPLETED.
Final Domain-Entity state serialized & saved to Event Store

svg.text: StackSaga Architecture — Saga Orchestration Engine State Progression
